name: Cinder & Bun
title: Cinder & Bun | Halal smash burgers in Peckham, order for collection
description: Halal smash burgers, crispy fries and thick shakes in Peckham. Build your order and send it on WhatsApp. Pay on collection, no app fees.

hero.sub: Beef pressed onto a screaming hot grill until the edges go lacy and dark. Cheese, pickles, brioche. Ready in ten minutes.
hero.subject_alt: A double smash burger with melted cheese, pickles and burnt-onion mayo

steps.d: Tap to add. Change your mind as many times as you like.
One tap and your order lands straight with the kitchen.
Walk in, grab the bag, pay at the counter.

feature.title: The Cinder Double
feature.text: Two smashed patties, two slices of melted cheese, pickles and burnt-onion mayo on a toasted brioche bun.

items.name: The Cinder Single
items.desc: Smashed patty, American cheese, pickles, burnt-onion mayo, brioche.

items.name: The Cinder Double
items.desc: Two smashed patties, double cheese, pickles, burnt-onion mayo.

items.name: Smoky Triple
items.desc: Three patties, smoked cheese, crispy onions, smoky sauce. Bring an appetite.

items.name: Hot Honey Chicken
items.desc: Crispy chicken thigh, hot honey, crunchy slaw, pickles.

items.name: Veg Smash
items.desc: Crispy plant patty, cheese, lettuce, tomato, house sauce.

items.name: Skin-on Fries
items.desc: Salted, crisp, a bit too easy to finish.

items.name: Cinder Cheese Fries
items.desc: Fries, cheese sauce, crispy onions, burnt-onion mayo.

items.name: Salted Caramel Shake
items.desc: Thick enough to need a spoon first.

visit.note: No alcohol served. Allergies? Tell us when you order and we will talk you through it.
